$Comment: Scoped aim for the M40. Wielding here, unlike the other guns: the sniper hides the first-person weapon and covers the screen with the scope overlay, so the guard reticle Wielding draws is not visible anyway. Heavy slowdown and no sprint are the cost of a 10x scope. CancelOnOtherClick is false so firing does not drop the scope. ScreenEffects/Sniper.png is a vanilla texture -- deliberately, since this pack's own reticle images were deleted.
